findings: The print says the first detection (2015) came from two colliding neutron stars, while topic 8.7 says the 14 September 2015 waves came from two black holes; the lesson keeps both statements and notes the black-hole account. The print also has 'Compact Binary Inspirational' (inspiral) and 'wrap' (warp). Recorded as findings.
